name: example
description: Neutral starter style pack. Copy to brands/<your-brand>.json and edit. Paths are relative to this file.

font.note: family is a Pango/fontconfig list: the first installed one wins. To pin a font, download an OFL font (e.g. Inter, Anton, Montserrat from Google Fonts) and set file to its .ttf path, or pass --font-file. Do not commit commercial fonts.
